description: This file defines the Unique class, which implements the UNIQUE function used within spreadsheet calculations to find unique values in a range or array, optionally filtering for values that occur only once and allowing selection by row or column.

classes.name: Unique
classes.description: Class implementing the UNIQUE function to extract unique values from a range or array, with options to filter for values that occur exactly once and to differentiate by row or column.

methods.name: unique
methods.description: Main public method to obtain unique values from a lookup vector, with options for filtering and orientation.

methods.name: uniqueByRow
methods.description: Private method to find unique entries by row from an array, optionally filtering for values that occur exactly once.

methods.name: uniqueByColumn
methods.description: Private method to find unique entries by column from an array, handling column orientation and filtering.

methods.name: countValuesCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Counts occurrences of values in an array, case-insensitively, and returns an array of counts keyed by the original values.

methods.name: exactlyOnceFilter
methods.description: Filters an array of counts to retain only those values which occur exactly once.
